confirmed_issues.title: Signature Mismatch in isDestructiveAction across jev-client.js and jev-vetter.js
Omission of Native Windows Command & Shell Aliases in isDestructiveAction

remediation.proposed_action:
Add Windows aliases and PowerShell Core to destructiveCmdPatterns:
- /\b(rd|rmdir)\s+(\/[a-z]\s+)*\/[sq]/i
- /\berase\s+(\/[a-z]\s+)*\/[fq]/i
- /\b(remove-item|ri|rmdir|del)\b.*(-r|-recurse).*(-fo|-force)/i
- Update encoded command regex to: /(powershell|pwsh)(\.exe)?\s+.*-(enc|encodedcommand|e)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)/i

confirmed_issues.title: Path Normalization Lacking Windows Backslash Support & Relative Traversal in sensitive-guard.js
Nested Sensitive Directory Traversal: Omitting Files Inside Secret Folders in sensitive-guard.js
Malformed JSON Tool Calls in safeParseJson Falling Back to Empty Object and Bypassing Destructive Gate
Hybrid Workspace Ecosystem Contamination in manifest-sniffer.js Triggering False Core Law Vetoes

remediation.proposed_action:
Refine isGasContext:
If .clasp.json exists, read its 'rootDir' setting if available. Only return true if filePath is inside clasp rootDir, or ends with .gs, or is inside a /gas/, /appsscript/, or /clasp/ directory, or contains GAS APIs. If filePath has typical frontend/web extensions (.tsx, .jsx, .vue, .svelte, .py) and does NOT contain GAS APIs, do NOT flag it as GAS.

confirmed_issues.title: Test Runner Output Parser Blindspots in runner-parser.js (Mocha, TAP Streams, 100% Skipped)

remediation.proposed_action:
Add to runner-parser.js:
- Mocha failure parser: combined.match(/(\d+)\s+passing.*(\d+)\s+failing/is) or /(\d+)\s+failing/i
- TAP stream parser: /^not ok\s+\d+/m or /# fail\s+([1-9]\d*)/i
- Skipped-only detection: combined.match(/Tests:\s+(\d+)\s+skipped,\s+(\d+)\s+total/i) -> if skipped === total, return passed: false
